deadline.value: The civil engineering PhD page gives no application deadline.

supervisor.value: Applicants are admitted based on research interests and openings in the research groups, so a faculty match comes before admission.
supervisor.quote: Applicants are admitted based on their research interests and openings in the research groups

funding.value: The page does not describe funding for PhD students.

entry_route.value: A four-year B.S. in civil engineering or a closely related field; the page names no master's route.
entry_route.quote: A four-year B.S. degree in Civil Engineering, or closely related engineering and science disciplines

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study
